breakdown.description: Numerical method section contains conflicting time-integration / solver instructions.
breakdown.reason: The original prompt contained conflicting instructions for the numerical method, specifying both 'Explicit forward Euler' and a detailed 'Strang splitting' scheme. The ground truth resolved this by removing the 'Explicit forward Euler' instruction. The agent failed to resolve this conflict and instead combined the two contradictory instructions, stating to 'Integrate in time with explicit forward Euler using Strang splitting'. This is incorrect as the described Strang splitting method is not an explicit forward Euler scheme.
